_comment: LAYER 2 — service and rental pricing for the FICTIONAL Prime Auto Garage & Rentals demo. DUMMY / PLACEHOLDER values only. Mirrors data/canopy_commercial.json's is_dummy convention. The agent must ALWAYS speak these as indicative, confirmed by the team — never as a final bill or confirmed rental rate.

fees.indicative_fee: around ₹1,500 to 3,500 (labour + basic consumables; parts extra)
around ₹800 to 1,500, depending on oil grade

fee_basis: Service costs depend on the exact vehicle model, parts needed, and labour — the team confirms the final bill after inspection. Rental rates depend on duration (daily/weekly/monthly rates differ) and self-drive vs chauffeur.
deposit_note: The rental security deposit is separate from the daily rate and is refunded after the vehicle is returned in good condition, minus any damage or fuel-policy deductions.
payment_note: Cash, card and UPI are accepted at the garage. Card/UPI/payment details are never collected over a phone call.
disclaimer: Indicative only. Exact service cost is confirmed after physical inspection; exact rental rate and availability are confirmed by the team before pickup. Never quote either as final over the phone.
